ValidationRule.description: DIR-763: Pending Approval, Approved, Rejected and Expired are set only by system automation (bypass flag) - not manually by RM/Specialist. Respects the RES_Config_Switch kill switch.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.RES_Config_Switch__c.RES_Validation_Rules_Off__c), ISCHANGED(Status), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Pending Approval"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Rejected"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Expired") ), NOT(RES_System_Status_Update__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Pending Approval, Approved, Rejected and Expired are set automatically by system processes and can't be changed manually.
